g.text: N24: finite effects of fixed native channel groups
13 reused development decisions. Ranges are case minima/maxima, not confidence intervals. Nested 16 is descriptive.
Panel C uses the same eight discovery cases; the dotted line is equality, with no fitted correction.
Full-state opposite scale: mean 13.675, range 9.109 to 19.695. This is not a mediation estimate.
Zero new completions or training. Prior program-level nulls remain unchanged; no semantic role or coding gain is established.
